narr: Monsoon moisture fueled scattered thunderstorms over northwest Arizona. A few storms produced flash flooding and severe weather.
lsr: HACKBERRY ROAD IS CLOSED FROM US 66 TO MAIN STREET DUE TO FLOODING.
ARIZONA DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION REPORTS THAT INTERSTATE 40 EASTBOUND IS CLOSED FROM MILEPOST 6 TO STATE ROUTE 95 DUE TO A MUD SLIDE. TIME OF MUDSLIDE ESTIMATED BY RADAR.
